facts.business: Soma Textiles & Industries Limited is a textile manufacturing company that has closed its Ahmedabad manufacturing unit and is involved in related party transactions for road projects and precast concrete business.

auditor.name: M/s. Pipara & Co.LLP, Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on exceptional items including foreign exchange gain on loan to associate Soma Textiles FZC (Rs 337.19 lakhs) and profit on sale of fixed assets (Rs 274.40 lakhs); also note on loan to associate with accumulated losses

facts.related_party_note: Related party transactions with Roadway Solutions India Infra Limited (purchase of goods/services for road project from FY 2025-26 to FY 2027-28, advance of Rs 5,832.57 lakhs) and Roadways Solutions Precast Concrete Pvt Ltd (advance of Rs 8,110 lakhs for one-time acquisition expected to complete in FY 2026-27)
